shortDescription: Resource module for Selfsigned Certificate Generate

options.name: admin
options.description: Use certificate to authenticate the Cisco ISE Admin Portal.

options.name: allowExtendedValidity
options.description: Allow generation of self-signed certificate with validity greater than 398 days.

options.name: allowPortalTagTransferForSameSubject
options.description: Allow overwriting the portal tag from matching certificate of same subject.

options.name: allowReplacementOfCertificates
options.description: Allow Replacement of certificates.

options.name: allowReplacementOfPortalGroupTag
options.description: Allow Replacement of Portal Group Tag.

options.name: allowRoleTransferForSameSubject
options.description: Allow transfer of roles for certificate with matching subject.

options.name: allowSanDnsBadName
options.description: Allow usage of SAN DNS Bad name.

options.name: allowSanDnsNonResolvable
options.description: Allow use of non resolvable Common Name or SAN Values.

options.name: allowWildCardCertificates
options.description: Allow Wildcard Certificates.

options.name: certificatePolicies
options.description: Certificate Policies.

options.name: digestType
options.description: Digest to sign with.

options.name: eap
options.description: Use certificate for EAP protocols that use SSL/TLS tunneling.

options.name: expirationTTL
options.description: Certificate expiration value.

options.name: expirationTTLUnit
options.description: Certificate expiration unit.

options.name: hostName
options.description: Hostname of the Cisco ISE node in which self-signed certificate should be generated.

options.name: ise_debug
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: ise_hostname
options.description: The Identity Services Engine hostname.

options.name: ise_password
options.description: The Identity Services Engine password to authenticate.

options.name: ise_single_request_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for RESTful HTTP requests.

options.name: ise_username
options.description: The Identity Services Engine username to authenticate.

options.name: ise_uses_api_gateway
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether to use the Identity Services Engine's API Gateway to send requests. If it is true, it uses the ISE's API Gateway and sends requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}. If it is false, it sends the requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}:{{port}}, where the port value depends on the Service used (ERS, Mnt, UI, PxGrid).

options.name: ise_uses_csrf_token
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether we send the CSRF token to ISE's ERS APIs. If it is True, the SDK assumes that your ISE CSRF Check is enabled. If it is True, it assumes you need the SDK to manage the CSRF token automatically for you.

options.name: ise_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: ise_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Identity Services Engine to use.

options.name: ise_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable automatic rate-limit handling.

options.name: keyLength
options.description: Bit size of public key.

options.name: keyType
options.description: Algorithm to use for certificate public key creation.

options.name: name
options.description: Friendly name of the certificate.

options.name: portal
options.description: Use for portal.

options.name: portalGroupTag
options.description: Set Group tag.

options.name: pxgrid
options.description: Use certificate for the pxGrid Controller.

options.name: radius
options.description: Use certificate for the RADSec server.

options.name: saml
options.description: Use certificate for SAML Signing.

options.name: sanDNS
options.description: Array of SAN (Subject Alternative Name) DNS entries.

options.name: sanIP
options.description: Array of SAN IP entries.

options.name: sanURI
options.description: Array of SAN URI entries.

options.name: subjectCity
options.description: Certificate city or locality (L).

options.name: subjectCommonName
options.description: Certificate common name (CN).

options.name: subjectCountry
options.description: Certificate country (C).

options.name: subjectOrg
options.description: Certificate organization (O).

options.name: subjectOrgUnit
options.description: Certificate organizational unit (OU).

options.name: subjectState
options.description: Certificate state (ST).
